what: Paint-over projection material (web/shaders/paintover): GPU pass against the float64 CPU reference on Lamp Quay G-buffers
source: fixtures/harbour-render.mjs G-buffers; paintings by paintover/painter.mjs at 384 x 216 (overscan scale 10.8); view 192 x 108 (scale 9)
why: Coverage is a decision (inside the painting, facing, not hidden) and the colour is a blend of bilinear samples. f32 against f64 can flip a coverage decision only within rounding of an edge or a depth tolerance; a flip changes one pixel by a whole colour, so the bounds are fractions of pixels.
